system.description: You've built a new capability into one of your automatons—it can erect a translucent level 5 force field around itself and anyone within immediate range of it until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery. Any creature protected by the field reduces incoming wounds by one severity (NPCs take 3 less damage). Enabler.
